title: My offers
description: Keep track of the offers you've sent and the tasks you're booked for.

invites.title: Invites
invites.sheetDescription: Review the proposed terms and respond to your client.
invites.empty: No invites yet. Requests from clients will appear here.

active.title: No active offers
active.body: Offers you've sent appear here while you wait for the client. Find a task to send your first offer.

booked.title: No booked offers yet
booked.body: When a client books your offer, you'll see it here. Browse open tasks to find your next one.

closed.title: No closed offers
closed.body: Offers that are not selected, withdrawn, or expired appear here. Find an open task to send another offer.
